name: Legal Reply to S.138 NI Act Demand Notice
description: Standard response to Section 138 negotiable instruments notice asserting security cheque misuse and pre-existing dispute.
defaultContent:
BEFORE THE HON'BLE METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE COURT / IN REPLY TO NOTICE DATED [DATE]

To,
[Complainant Counsel Name / Address]

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of our client, Meridian Infra Holdings Ltd having its registered office at Level 14, Meridian Tower, Lower Parel, Mumbai, we hereby reply to your notice as follows:

1. At the very outset, our client denies each and every allegation, contention, and claim made in your notice under reply as baseless, frivolous, and contrary to records.

2. Our client states that Cheque No. [CHEQUE_NUMBER] was handed over strictly as a security deposit under the Agreement dated [DATE], and was never intended for presentation without joint reconciliation.

3. [BLANK_STATEMENT: Insert details of supply defect or credit note].

4. In view of the above, no debt or liability as contemplated under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 ever arose. You are hereby called upon to forthwith withdraw your notice.

Yours faithfully,
Advocate for Meridian Infra Holdings Ltd

name: Reply to Show Cause Notice DRC-01 (GST ITC Mismatch)
description: Statutory reply under Section 73/74 defending Input Tax Credit mismatch between GSTR-3B and GSTR-2A/2B using CBIC Circular 183.
defaultContent:
BEFORE THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF STATE TAX, LARGE TAXPAYERS UNIT, MUMBAI

IN RE: SHOW CAUSE NOTICE REF: [SCN_REF] DATED [DATE]

REPLY ON BEHALF OF: MERIDIAN REALTY PVT LTD (GSTIN: [GSTIN_NO])

Respected Officer,

1. The Assessee is in receipt of the Show Cause Notice alleging ITC mismatch of ₹ [DEMAND_AMOUNT].

2. It is submitted that the Assessee has strictly fulfilled all conditions prescribed under Section 16(2) of the CGST Act, 2017:
a) The Assessee possesses valid tax invoices;
b) The goods/services were duly received;
c) The tax charged has actually been paid to the Government by the supplier;
d) The Assessee has furnished returns under Section 39.

3. Reliance is placed on CBIC Circular No. 183/15/2022-GST dated 27.12.2022 and Circular No. 193/05/2023-GST which provide clarity on handling mismatches.

4. [BLANK_STATEMENT: State details of Chartered Accountant certificate u/c 183].

It is therefore prayed that the proposed demand and penalty be dropped in toto.
